_meta.label: Endometrioid carcinoma
_meta.scope: Every efficacy figure is copied from data/trials_oec.json; toxicity from data/tox.json or data/tox_histotypes.json; label rules from data/labels.json or data/labels_histotypes.json. "base" inherits drugs, drug classes, tox_ref, PFS text, risk_rules and ledger_rules from the named HGSC record.
_meta.tier_reading: No randomised trial reports an OEC effect estimate in any setting, so tiers 1–3 are empty by construction. Tier 5 = randomised subgroup with no efficacy difference (GOG-157 OEC HR 1.07, 6 vs 3 cycles). Tier 6 = OEC included but not broken out (carboplatin–paclitaxel, bevacizumab, PARPi by biomarker), biomarker-selected extrapolation (BRCA → PARPi; MMRd → pembrolizumab; HER2 3+ → T-DXd; ER/PR → endocrine), or observational. Tier 7 = negative OEC-specific result (pembrolizumab unselected 0/28), harm (PARPi instead of chemotherapy), or OEC excluded.
_meta.molecular_class_note: The endometrial molecular classes (POLEmut / MMRd / NSMP / p53abn) apply to OEC and separate prognosis, but no trial has used them to select OEC treatment. The ranker uses mol_class only as (a) the MMRd gate for pembrolizumab and (b) a WT1 warning: a WT1-positive p53abn tumour is HGSC and belongs on the HGSC page.

regimens.name: Observation after complete staging (stage IA/IB, grade 1–2)

os.median: ICON1 + ACTION OEC subgroup (deaths only, n=223): 13/94 chemotherapy vs 20/129 observation; no difference in effect across cell types (P=.55); no OEC HR. SEER (observational): no benefit in stage IA/IB regardless of grade

qualifiers: Stage IA/IB grade 1–2 OEC was not eligible for GOG-157 or GOG-175; the case for or against chemotherapy there is observational only
POLEmut OEC had no progression events in pooled data (n=785) — the obvious de-escalation candidate, untested as a selector
A WT1-negative p53abn tumour is the OEC class with the worst prognosis; observation is not supported there

prefer_when.reason: Low-grade stage I: no survival association with chemotherapy in either SEER series
POLEmut: pooled 5-yr PFS 100%, no events (extrapolated from the endometrial class, not trial-tested in OEC)

risk_rules.reason: Stage IC grade 3 is the one consistent observational signal for chemotherapy (OS HR 0.583, Oseledchyk)
p53abn OEC: median OS 4.7 yr, the worst class; confirm WT1-negative, then treat as high-risk
Stage II: ICON1/ACTION favoured chemotherapy trial-wide; the observational no-benefit data are stage I only

regimens.name: Carboplatin + paclitaxel × 3 cycles

tox_ref.note: G3–4 neurotoxicity 2% (vs 11% with 6 cycles); G4 granulocytopenia 52%

pfs.text: GOG-157 OEC (n=105, 25%): recurrence HR 1.07 (0.47–2.44) for 6 vs 3 cycles — no signal that OEC needs more than 3

qualifiers: Three cycles is the GOG-157 standard arm; the OEC subgroup shows nothing for six
Eligibility in GOG-157/175 was IC, II or grade 3: this is the stage IC / grade 3 regimen, not a stage IA/IB one

prefer_when.reason: Stage IC grade 3: observational OS HR 0.583 with chemotherapy
